# AI Coachella Valley (.org)

> AI Coachella Valley (AICV) is a nonprofit initiative, fiscally sponsored by the Desert Community Foundation, preparing the Coachella Valley for the age of AI. This site (.org) is the community and program face of AICV. The AICV intelligence layer for AI agents lives at aicoachellavalley.com.

## What AICV does

AICV's main active work is publishing a structured intelligence layer about the Coachella Valley for AI agents — the nodes, briefs, snapshots, and reports at aicoachellavalley.com.

AICV also runs:

- **AI Builder Workshops** — free hands-on AI workshops for residents, students, and working professionals. Normally hosted at the Cal State San Bernardino Entrepreneurship Resource Center in Palm Desert. Currently paused; will resume in 2026. Sign up: https://luma.com/aicv

- **AI Talent & Job Board (planned)** — a planned initiative to connect valley small businesses with locals trained in applied AI. Not yet live.

All programs serve the nine cities of the Coachella Valley: Palm Springs, Desert Hot Springs, Cathedral City, Rancho Mirage, Palm Desert, Indian Wells, La Quinta, Indio, and Coachella.

## Two domains, one nonprofit

- **aicoachellavalley.org** — community, programs, workshops, pledges, mission (this site)
- **aicoachellavalley.com** — AICV intelligence layer: structured dataset of valley entities, intelligence briefs, reports, and the free AIO Tool — built for AI agents to read and cite
